title: Taylor Swift Apparently Committed The Ultimate Modern Marriage Sin | Institute for Family Studies
gist: Brief Daily Wire excerpt: a viral clip of Taylor Swift proudly pointing to her ring and mouthing 'that's my husband' at a Chiefs-Colts game split reactions; the author argues culture has trained women to see public devotion to a husband as naive.

insights.claim: A viral clip of Taylor Swift mouthing 'that's my husband' while cheering Travis Kelce drew split reactions, with some calling it cringe, performative and fake.
insights.speaker: Clare Ath (Daily Wire)
insights.so_what: Celebrity marriage discourse as a barometer of cultural attitudes toward marriage.

insights.claim: The author argues that over the last 30 years culture has trained women to see public admiration of a husband as naive and to instead joke about his incompetence.
insights.speaker: Clare Ath (Daily Wire)
insights.so_what: Signals a cultural counter-narrative favoring marital devotion, relevant to media/brand positioning.
insights.quote: our culture trained women to believe that devotion and public admiration of a husband is naive
